Love for video games (not just ours!)

jobs.description: Position Overview At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. As Software Engineer Sr. within PNC's Technology organization, you can be based in Pittsburgh PA (preferred), Strongsville OH, Birmingham AL, Phoenix AZ or Dallas TX. PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position. You will be part of a team responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automation solutions supporting enterprise database platforms. The role combines strong Oracle DBA expertise with software engineering, infrastructure automation, platform engineering, and operational excellence. The successful candidate will lead efforts to automate database provisioning, patching, compliance validation, monitoring, reporting, vulnerability remediation, and operational processes. Maintain code repositories, documentation, and automation standards. Integrate automation with enterprise tooling, APIs, and CI/CD pipelines. Support Oracle RAC, ASM, Multitenant, RMAN, Data Guard, Fleet Patching and Provisioning, Enterprise Manager, Exadata, and Recovery Appliance technologies. Design and automate database build, patching, cloning, migration, backup, recovery, and validation processes. Troubleshoot complex database and infrastructure issues. Multi Platform Database Automation Expand automation capabilities beyond Oracle to support enterprise database platforms including: SQL Server PostgreSQL MySQL MongoDB Future database technologies adopted by the organization Develop platform agnostic engineering patterns whenever practical. Partner with database platform engineering teams to identify automation opportunities and standardize operational workflows.
